checks.name: every trial subtotal counts the trial and trl codes, and nothing else
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.subscription_activity a left join (select subscription_id, count(*) filter (where lower(trim(tier_code)) in ('trial', 'trl')) as trials from raw.billing_events group by subscription_id) r using (subscription_id) where a.trial_event_count is distinct from coalesce(r.trials, 0)

checks.name: every event total and paid subtotal is unchanged
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.subscription_activity a left join (select subscription_id, count(*) as events, count(*) filter (where lower(trim(tier_code)) = 'paid') as paid from raw.billing_events group by subscription_id) r using (subscription_id) where a.event_count is distinct from coalesce(r.events, 0) or a.paid_event_count is distinct from coalesce(r.paid, 0)

checks.name: every customer subscription keeps exactly one row and internal ones stay out
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from raw.subscriptions where not is_internal) - (select count(distinct subscription_id) from main.subscription_activity) + (select count(*) - count(distinct subscription_id) from main.subscription_activity) + (select count(*) from main.subscription_activity a join raw.subscriptions s using (subscription_id) where s.is_internal)

checks.name: the unplaced pro-trial code is not counted as a trial
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.stg_events e join raw.billing_events r using (event_id) where lower(trim(r.tier_code)) = 'pro-trial' and e.event_tier = 'trial'
